zh: 修复视频壁纸在桌面端整页不显示：视频层在负 z-index 上，宿主画布把脱离层叠上下文的孩子压到文档背景之下，卸载视频层时同时停止解码。
en: Fix the video wallpaper painting nothing on desktop: its layer sits at a negative z-index and the host canvas drops a child outside a stacking context below the document background; unmounting the layer now pauses the video too.
